blurb_en:
Washington just banned Chinese robot dogs — and their two-legged counterparts — from the US market, adding humanoid and quadruped robots to the FCC's national-security Covered List.
• Chinese manufacturers hold roughly 85% of the global humanoid robot market. The ban applies to new FCC authorizations only — units already in the US are not affected.
• The White House task force cited risks to "critical infrastructure" and "the safety and security of US residents" — verbatim from the Huawei rationale used four years ago.
• The ruling also sweeps in Chinese-made power inverters, catching grid-connected batteries and data center power systems in the same security designation.
• Beijing called it protectionism. A September Trump-Xi summit remains on the calendar.
• For Insta360 employees: the Covered List has expanded from telecom equipment to security cameras to robot hardware. The category of "Chinese-made AI devices with connectivity" keeps widening.
• The FCC just added bipedal robots to the same list as Huawei routers. The hardware gets more limbs with every update.
blurb_zh:
美国联邦通信委员会周二将人形机器人和四足机器人列入国家安全禁止名单，正式将中国机器人制造商拒之门外——而后者占据全球人形机器人市场约85%的份额。
• 禁令仅针对新型号FCC授权，美国市场已有库存暂不受影响。
• 禁令援引的理由与当初封禁华为如出一辙：外国硬件可能威胁「关键基础设施」与「美国居民安全」。
• 禁令范围同样覆盖中国制造的电力逆变器，涉及电网储能、可再生能源及数据中心供电设备。
• 北京斥之为保护主义。中美九月峰会日程未变。
• 对Insta360员工：禁令名单的覆盖范围正从通信设备扩展至安防摄像头，再到机器人。具备网络连接能力的中国AI硬件，都在这条线上。
• FCC刚把双足机器人加进了和华为路由器同一张名单。每次更新，上面的硬件都多了几条腿。
verification_notes: Confirmed via Washington Post primary, Forbes, CBS News, NBC News, NPR, The Hill — all July 28-29 2026

blurb_en:
Elon Musk posted a three-minute Grok Imagine clip of Odysseus and Calypso on Wednesday and promised a full-length, "historically accurate" AI Odyssey before the year ends — no director, no screenplay, no cast listed.
• Christopher Nolan's Odyssey opened the same week to $264 million globally. Musk has been publicly attacking the film's casting since February.
• Homer's Odyssey features gods intervening in human affairs, a one-eyed giant, and a sorceress who turns men into pigs. Musk considers this "historically accurate."
• Grok Imagine has no production team, no confirmed release platform, and no budget announced. Musk provided none of these details.
• PetaPixel noted Grok Imagine is the same model that previously generated Musk in various world-historical roles without being asked.
• For Insta360 employees: if a three-minute AI clip can drive mainstream debate about what counts as authentic filmmaking, the definition of "cinematic content" is being rewritten in real time.
• The real question isn't whether Grok can finish the Odyssey. It's whether Musk thinks the announcement is the film.
blurb_zh:
马斯克周三在X发布了一段三分钟的Grok Imagine生成视频——奥德修斯与仙女卡吕普索的对话——随即宣布将在年底前推出一部「历史准确」的全长版《奥德赛》，由AI独家完成。
• 时机精准：诺兰版《奥德赛》同周全球上映，首周票房达2.64亿美元，而马斯克自今年2月起持续公开抨击影片选角。
• 荷马的《奥德赛》充满神明降临、独眼巨人和魔法变形——这正是马斯克口中「历史准确」的素材来源。
• 目前Grok Imagine没有剧本、没有导演、没有演员表，也没有公布发行平台。
• 对Insta360员工：如果一段三分钟AI短片就能引发关于「电影真实性」的全球舆论战，AI内容与专业影像的界限正在消失。
• 这部AI电影能否完成，是次要问题——马斯克显然清楚，宣布本身就已经是内容了。
verification_notes: Confirmed via Variety primary (July 22), Deadline, Hollywood Reporter, CNN, PetaPixel (July 23) — all consistent on facts

blurb_en:
Substack launched an AI-transparency feature on July 21 powered by Pangram that scores any post as AI-generated, AI-assisted, or human-written — whether the author opted in or not.
• Default setting: on. Writers can add a disclosure and disable scanning on their own content, but readers can still run a scan at any time.
• 404 Media documented a post that scored 100% AI on one scan and 100% human on the next, with no changes to the text.
• AI detection models have a documented failure rate on non-native English speakers and neurodiverse writers, whose prose patterns fall outside training data.
• CEO Chris Best's stated goal: stop Substack from becoming LinkedIn.
• The tool is supposed to protect readers from AI slop. So far it is producing some of its own.
blurb_zh:
Substack于7月21日推出AI内容检测功能，依托Pangram模型将任何文章标记为「AI生成」「AI辅助」或「人工写作」——无论作者是否同意。
• 默认开启。作者可添加声明或关闭自己内容的扫描，但读者仍可随时主动发起检测。
• 404 Media记录了同一篇文章连续两次扫描，结果分别为「100%AI」和「100%人工」。
• AI检测工具的已知盲区：非母语英语写作者和神经多样性作者的写作风格往往触发误报。
• CEO的目标：阻止Substack变成下一个LinkedIn。
• 这款工具本来是为了识别AI内容，但目前它自己产出的误判已经够多了。
verification_notes: Confirmed via Axios primary (July 23), 404 Media witch hunt article, Jane Friedman breakdown, Substack support pages

blurb_en:
Meta sold 80% of its half-built El Paso data center to BlackRock-managed funds on Tuesday, collected $4.9 billion in fresh cash, and kept full operational control of the 1-gigawatt campus.
• Total development cost: approximately $14 billion. BlackRock financed $12.5 billion of its stake through debt; Meta contributed roughly $2.3 billion in land and construction already underway.
• Meta retains operational control, construction management, and property management. BlackRock owns the building; Meta still runs it.
• The ownership structure is close to selling your house, pocketing the money, and refusing to leave — while still managing the maintenance.
• BlackRock also pledged $30 million to train 12,000 electricians in Texas. Useful optics for municipal approval.
• For Insta360 employees: 1 gigawatt is the scale at which next-generation AI models get trained. The companies locking in this infrastructure are the ones setting the pace of the next cycle.
blurb_zh:
Meta周二将旗下在建的德克萨斯埃尔帕索数据中心80%股权出售给贝莱德管理基金，套现约49亿美元，同时保留这座1吉瓦园区的全部运营控制权。
• 项目总开发成本约140亿美元；贝莱德以125亿美元债务融资出资，Meta以已建设的土地及设施折合约23亿美元入股。
• Meta保留运营权、施工管理权和物业管理权。贝莱德买了楼，Meta继续掌钥匙。
• 相当于把房子卖了、装进钱、但坚持住在里面，并告诉物业怎么干活。
• 贝莱德还承诺向得克萨斯州投入3000万美元，为1.2万名电工提供培训。
• 对Insta360员工：1吉瓦算力就是下一代AI模型的训练规模。锁定这些基础设施的公司，正在决定下一轮AI的节奏。
verification_notes: Confirmed via CNBC primary, Forbes, Yahoo Finance, Meta official press release on about.fb.com, PR Newswire — all July 28 2026
